name: ProjectCostForecastWorkbench
tagline: The monthly cost report, forecast and approval in one Power Apps component.
description: Complete construction cost report and forecasting module in one Power Apps code component: original budget, approved and pending changes, committed and actual cost, cost to complete with four forecast methods, EAC and forecast final cost, variance and period movement by cost code and package, CPI and earned value, a Draft → Submitted → Approved forecast workflow with variance commentary and segregation of duties, cost bridge and package analysis.
features: Cost bridge from original budget to forecast final cost
Four forecast methods with comparison and bulk apply
EAC, forecast final cost, variance and variance %
Pending change exposure and risk allowance options
Submit / approve / return workflow with variance commentary
Stale-forecast reminders and cost report summary text
Grouping with subtotals and CSV export
